_note: Core mechanics the scheduler depends on. Edit to fix mistakes. Assumptions show an 'unverified' tag in the app until you confirm them there, or set "verified": true here.

assumptions.text: Each level gives 1 stat point to spend.
A declined skill still counts as passed: the Magatama moves on to its next skill and the declined skill is gone for good.
A new game starts with 2 in every stat and Marogareh as the only Magatama.
